svg.aria-label: systolic pipeline fill, steady state and drain
svg.text: ROWS=4 COLS=2, 6 activation vectors streamed back to back; numbers are the sample index each PE is working on
All 8 PEs hold a live activation simultaneously for 2 cycles; every PE performs exactly 6 MACs, one per cycle, with no gaps.
Array phase is s_count + ROWS + COLS = 6 + 4 + 2 = 12 cycles, of which 5 are fill and 1 drain.
